items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: Freddie Locano's got a banjo in the picture.

ctx.x: He had a good, he had a cool tone. But that clad was the best tone. He used a stiff read to him on a three and a half.

Well, you see, I never heard him play sax, really, except maybe in the section. Here's this band at the Little Club. Prima Chalkman, the orchestra, 1930. With Charlie Hawkman on the trombone. Oh yeah, Charlie Hawkman was a good band. I told him on that. Chalky Leon, Prima, Foss, Winstyn, Unifacon. Yeah, what's his setup? Same setup, Schilling. Yeah, same setup, Louis Macenton too, but I had Sussaphone. Yeah, he was a single, but he also played string bass too. Yeah, and Freddie Locano's got a banjo in the…
Alto and Clarinet. He played a fine clarinet.
